newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton gets $15/shr offer from Belco.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton gets $15/shr offer from Belco.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said it received a $15-per-share acquisition proposal from Belco Oil & Gas Corp.
The offer consisted of $5 in cash and $10 in Belco common stock, Hugoton said.
Belco had previously acquired 2.94 million shares of Hugoton common stock, representing 14.9 percent of total outstanding shares, in a private transaction, it said.

The acquisition is proposed as a tax-free exchange of stock for the non-cash portion and is subject to completion of due diligence by both companies and execution of a definitive merger agreement, Hugoton said.
Hugoton said it signed an exclusivity agreement with Belco until July 11 to allow Hugoton to fully evaluate the proposal.

"Hugoton intends to continue working with its financial advisors, Petrie Parkman & Co, to evaluate various strategic alternatives available to the company. These alternatives include a sale of the company, a merger with another company or remaining an independent company," Hugoton said.
Belco is an independent energy company engaged in the exploration, development and production of natural gas and oil. It operates in Texas, Louisiana, Wyoming, Michigan and Oklahoma, it said.

Hugoton is an independent oil and natural gas firm engaged in exploration and development, production and acquisition of oil and natural gas properties. The company is active in the Hugoton Field and has expanded its operations to other significant basins in the central United States, it said.
Belco announced its bid for Hugoton earlier Monday.
